messages:
Priya (Partnerships): quick thread  new SI wants marketplace onboarding + SI badge. aiming for a 5-week ramp: enablement, benching with HW partner, and listing. opinions?
Omar (SI Enablement): +1. propose: week0 docs + creds, week1 train-the-trainer, week2 lab with HW, week3 certification, week4 case study prep. keep certification lean.
Hana (Marketing): for marketplace listing we need logo, 40-word blurb, hero image, and a 1-page case study draft. need assets 7 business days before publish.
Luis (Solutions Eng): tech note: the HW vendor requires a firmware check and their bench harness needs SSH to the nodes. can we provision a short-lived test cluster?
Zoe (Legal): checklist: export compliance for HW, standard partner terms, and a short IP/CLA for runbooks. no public customer data in any collateral.
Omar (SI Enablement): cert criteria idea: complete lab script (verify p90 under threshold), submit runbook PR, trainer shadow session. then issue "Verified SI" tag.
Priya (Partnerships): metrics to track: time-to-first-deploy, #engineers trained, conversion to paid pilot, and marketplace leads from announce.
Luis (Solutions Eng): bench metrics to capture: p50/p90 latency, throughput (tokens/s), GPU mem, quant bits, and config used. we'll publish aggregated numbers only.
Hana (Marketing): suggest a co-announcement dry run with HW partner and SI 3 days prior. webinar 1 week after launch.
Zoe (Legal): will review SOW/template and the marketplace listing copy. ping me early.
reminder-bot: reminder set: 1967004000 -> "SI marketplace onboarding kickoff"
Priya (Partnerships): action items: Omar = schedule train & upload quiz; Luis = test cluster plan + bench script; Hana = creative checklist; Zoe = legal checklist. I'll send invite for Tue 11am PT. :white_check_mark:
